# @solana-programs/goki

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@solana-programs/goki.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/goki)

TypeScript client for Goki programs (Smart Wallet and Token Signer)

<!-- Generated by `bun run codegen` from programs/bundles.ts. Do not edit. -->

## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/goki @solana/kit
```

## Included programs

This package contains no code of its own: it re-exports everything from the following packages, which can also be installed individually:

- `smartWallet`: [`@solana-programs/goki-smart-wallet`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/goki-smart-wallet)
- `tokenSigner`: [`@solana-programs/goki-token-signer`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/goki-token-signer)
